scope: Chapters 15-30, all routes; continuation of Chapters 1-14 and prior Chapter 15 Super proofreading; source only

edits.speaker: Duke
edits.before: Ghh! Shoot i...!!
edits.after: Ghh! Shoot I...!!
edits.reason: Capitalize the interrupted Shoot In command while preserving its cutoff.

edits.speaker: Jigra
edits.before: Oh... You must have plenty of time to spare, protecting a woman on the battlefield, Duke Fleed. Then I'll send you both to hell!
edits.after: Oh... Feeling confident enough to protect a woman in battle, Duke Fleed? Then I'll send you both to hell!
edits.reason: Render composure in battle naturally; he is taunting Duke over his confidence, not spare time.

edits.speaker: Koji
edits.before: The Spazer... If Grendizer just had a Spazer! Genzo Umon, can't you send out the Double Spazer!?
edits.after: The Spazer... If Grendizer just had a Spazer! Dr. Umon, can't you send out the Double Spazer!?
edits.reason: Use the title in the Japanese address instead of substituting the doctor's full name.

edits.speaker: Michelo
edits.before: Hya-ha-ha-ha! A fly could fly as fast as it can and still never catch Heaven's Sword!
edits.after: Hya-ha-ha-ha! Even at top speed, a fly could never catch Heaven's Sword!
edits.reason: Remove the repetitive fly/could fly/as fast as it can phrasing while retaining the insult.

edits.speaker: Emary
edits.before: Don't worry. Captain Bright is the man I love in my heart.
edits.after: Don't worry. Captain Bright is the man of my dreams.
edits.reason: Replace the literal heart-lover phrasing with a natural English expression for her romantic ideal.

edits.speaker: Megumi
edits.before: Y-yes...
edits.after: N-no, it isn't...
edits.reason: Make the reply to the negative English question unambiguous: the creature is not a Saucer Beast.

edits.speaker: Boss
edits.before: Y-you bastards... You think this has nothing to do with you...!
edits.after: Y-you bastards... Easy for you to say when it's not your neck on the line...!
edits.reason: Use a natural English complaint that preserves his anger at those treating his danger as someone else's problem.

edits.speaker: Ruri
edits.before: I'm Major Ruri Hoshino of the Earth Federation Space Force.
edits.after: I'm Lieutenant Commander Ruri Hoshino of the Earth Federation Space Force.
edits.reason: Match the established naval rendering of Ruri's rank; the Japanese rank is unchanged.

edits.speaker: Yamasaki
edits.before: Let's put our earnest, duty-bound major's mind at ease.
edits.after: Let's put our earnest, duty-bound lieutenant commander's mind at ease.
edits.reason: Keep Ruri's established rank consistent in this reference.

edits.speaker: Ryoko
edits.before: Martian Successors, economic boom, whatever! You attacked us, so don't expect to leave in one piece!
edits.after: Martian Successors, Martian suckers, whatever! You attacked us, so don't expect to leave in one piece!
edits.reason: Adapt Ryoko's deliberately mangled faction name into an English sound-alike insult; the Japanese plays on successors and economic boom.

edits.speaker: Azuma
edits.before: All right! We'll let them cut our flesh so we can break their bones!!
edits.after: All right! We'll take a hit to land a killing blow!!
edits.reason: Render the flesh-and-bones proverb as a natural tactical idiom: accept a wound to strike decisively.

edits.speaker: Azuma
edits.before: Even a flying fly is easy to hit when it stops! Some sacrifices are unavoidable!!
edits.after: Once a fly stops moving, it's easy to swat! Some sacrifices are unavoidable!!
edits.reason: Remove the redundant flying fly phrasing and keep the proverb's meaning.

edits.before: 1. Allied units reach the destination
edits.after: 1. An allied unit reaches the destination
edits.reason: Clarify that reaching the goal with an allied unit satisfies the stated objective; the source does not require every unit.

edits.speaker: Ruri
edits.before: ...Hello. I'm Major Ruri Hoshino of the Federation Space Force.
edits.after: ...Hello. I'm Lieutenant Commander Ruri Hoshino of the Federation Space Force.
edits.reason: Use the established naval rendering of Ruri's rank consistently.

edits.speaker: Dr. Plato
edits.before: the Tekkoryu (Iron Dragon) with its special machines, Dolems, Angels and the like would be difficult.
edits.after: the Tekkoryu with its special machines, Dolems, Angels and the like would be difficult.
edits.reason: Remove an unnecessary parenthetical gloss from the established faction name.

edits.speaker: Akira
edits.before: Neither did I. But...
edits.after: Neither am I. But...
edits.reason: Match the present-tense statement that neither character fights because he wants to.

edits.speaker: #男愛称
edits.before: Folia Esto will never come back!!
edits.after: Folia Est will never come back!!
edits.reason: Use the same user-requested family surname as his father, Albero Est.

edits.speaker: Kaine
edits.before: We'll never be able to live in peace as long as the likes of Giganos, Tekkoryu (Iron Dragon) and Gulfer are around!
edits.after: We'll never be able to live in peace as long as the likes of Giganos, Tekkoryu and Gulfer are around!
edits.reason: Remove the unnecessary gloss after the established faction name.

edits.speaker: Dr. Plato
edits.before: It looks the same, but I've improved its software's processing power, armor and output.
edits.after: It looks the same, but I've improved its software's processing power, along with its armor and output.
edits.reason: Make clear that armor and output are properties of the machine, not of its software.

edits.speaker: Rom
edits.before: I'll be watching you show the new dragon's power!
edits.after: Let me see your new dragon power!
edits.reason: Replace the awkward watching-you-show construction with a natural request to demonstrate their new power.

edits.speaker: Albero
edits.before: Of course. That's my intention. Don't let AI1 have a rejection response.
edits.after: Of course. That's my intention. Make sure AI1 shows no signs of rejection.
edits.reason: Use natural English for the rejection response without changing the technical claim.

edits.speaker: #女愛称
edits.before: That machine should be an unmanned unit equipped with an artificial intelligence for combat.
edits.after: That machine should be unmanned, with a combat AI on board.
edits.reason: Use the established AI abbreviation and a concise description of the unmanned design.

edits.speaker: Tapp
edits.before: But weren't those two on Mars now?
edits.after: But weren't those two supposed to be on Mars?
edits.reason: Resolve the conflicting past-tense were and present-time now while preserving his surprise at their return.

edits.speaker: Prospector
edits.before: Giganos, Gulfer, MU... The Hyakki Empire and Tekkoryu (Iron Dragon)... Then the Vegan Empire, and on top of that, the Angels.
edits.after: Giganos, Gulfer, MU... The Hyakki Empire and Tekkoryu... Then the Vegan Empire, and on top of that, the Angels.
edits.reason: Remove the unnecessary gloss after the established faction name.

edits.speaker: Ruri
edits.before: Besides... I don't want to regret leaving people we could have saved without helping them.
edits.after: Besides... I don't want to regret turning my back on people we could save.
edits.reason: Remove the redundant leaving-without-helping construction while preserving her reason for intervening.

edits.speaker: Erika
edits.before: It seems you and we are parallel lines that will never meet.
edits.after: It seems we're on parallel paths that will never meet.
edits.reason: Make the parallel-lines metaphor natural in English without changing the refusal to compromise.

edits.speaker: Kusakabe
edits.before: He escaped from Mars with his companions and headed for the Earth region. Of course, we have already sent pursuers.
edits.after: He escaped from Mars with his companions and headed for the Earth Sphere. Of course, we have already sent pursuers.
edits.reason: Use the established Earth Sphere term for the source location.

edits.speaker: Misumaru
edits.before: You needn't say any more, Colonel. Simply knowing my daughter is alive is enough.
edits.after: You needn't say any more, Captain. Simply knowing my daughter is alive is enough.
edits.reason: Keep Bright's form of address consistent with the project's established naval rank.

edits.speaker: Burai
edits.before: Do not be hasty, Hidler. In this war... whoever judges the times will win in the end. Thus, we must first build up our strength now.
edits.after: Do not be hasty, Hidler. In this war, whoever reads the tide of events will win in the end. For now, we must build up our strength.
edits.reason: Replaces the literal 'judges the times' with natural English for assessing the changing strategic situation, while preserving Burai's instruction to wait and build strength.

edits.speaker: Koji
edits.before: What's wrong with showing Maria around the lab? It's not like it'll lose anything.
edits.after: What's wrong with showing Maria around the lab? It won't hurt anything.
edits.reason: The Japanese idiom means there is no harm in showing her around; 'it'll lose anything' sounds as though the laboratory itself loses possessions.

edits.speaker: Oki
edits.before: ...Masato, what was that way of fighting near the Science Fortress Laboratory?
edits.after: ...Masato, what were you thinking, fighting like that near the Science Fortress Laboratory?
edits.reason: Makes Oki's rebuke idiomatic English; he is challenging Masato's conduct, rather than asking for a description of a combat technique.

edits.speaker: Oki
edits.before: ...Indeed. That's why I believe you can understand our reason, Colonel.
edits.after: ...Indeed. That's why I believe you can understand our reason, Captain.
edits.reason: Uses the established character-specific naval rank for Bright; the same conversation already calls him Captain Bright.

edits.speaker: Masato
edits.before: I'm Akitsu... Masato Akitsu.
edits.after: I'm... Masato Akitsu.
edits.reason: Preserves Masato's hesitant introduction without awkwardly repeating his surname before his full English-order name.

edits.speaker: Miku
edits.before: To stop the Hau Dragon's ambitions.
edits.after: To stop Tekkoryu... Hau Dragon's ambitions.
edits.reason: Restores Miku's identification of Tekkoryu by its other name, Hau Dragon. The original explicitly links the two names.

edits.speaker: #女愛称
edits.before: I'll think about what I need to do so the two of us can get proper results together.
edits.after: I'll think about what I can do so the two of us can work effectively as a team.
edits.reason: Rephrases the literal 'get proper results together' as natural English while preserving Aqua's resolve to make their partnership work.

edits.speaker: Haruka
edits.before: Yes. We've received instructions, but...
edits.after: No. We've received instructions, but...
edits.reason: Haruka is confirming that Misato has not returned yet. In English, replying 'Yes' to this negative question can incorrectly suggest she has returned.

edits.speaker: Vega
edits.before: Launch next!
edits.after: Launch the remaining units!
edits.reason: Replaces the unnatural command 'Launch next!' with the order to send out RahXephon, EVA-02 and EVA-00 after EVA-01.

edits.speaker: Maya
edits.before: Improvisation is still far too early for you. You understand... don't you?
edits.after: You're not ready for improvisation yet. You understand... don't you?
edits.reason: The original says improvising is premature for Ayato. This gives the musical metaphor natural English phrasing instead of saying improvisation itself is 'too early'.

edits.speaker: Ayato
edits.before: I'm not here! There's no time here that I'm living through! I... I!
edits.after: I'm not really here! I'm not living my own life here! I... I!
edits.reason: Expresses Ayato's rejection of the illusory world's lived experience in natural English, replacing the confusing literal 'There's no time here that I'm living through'.

edits.speaker: Misato
edits.before: NERV isn't as soft as I thought.
edits.after: NERV isn't nearly as benign as I thought.
edits.reason: In context, Misato realizes NERV is more dangerous and deceptive than she assumed. 'Soft' does not clearly convey this realization in English.

edits.speaker: Saiga
edits.before: The way you move... You're not from the Earth sphere. A remnant of Mokuren, I'd wager?
edits.after: The way you move... You're not from the Earth Sphere. A remnant of the Jovian Federation, I'd wager?
edits.reason: Replaces untranslated 'Mokuren' with the established English faction name, Jovian Federation, and uses the standard Earth Sphere capitalization.

edits.speaker: Dr. Inoue
edits.before: Dendoh's basic combat movement patterns are based on the Shaolin kung fu Ginga is learning.
edits.after: Dendoh's basic combat movement patterns are based on the Shorinji Kempo Ginga is learning.
edits.reason: Ginga studies Shorinji Kempo, the specific Japanese martial art already distinguished in the glossary; it is not the Shaolin kung fu practiced by Sai Saici.

edits.speaker: Kazuya
edits.before: A boy at the temple gate learns to chant sutras without lessons... But their synchronization is impressive.
edits.after: Learning by osmosis, huh? Still, their synchronization is impressive.
edits.reason: Uses a natural English equivalent of the proverb about a boy learning temple chants through exposure. Kazuya is praising what Hokuto has picked up without formal lessons.

edits.speaker: Ginga
edits.before: Every martial artist in the world would cry with envy at this stew!
edits.after: It's a stew-ation that would make every martial artist in the world green with envy!
edits.reason: Adapts Ginga's mistaken shortening of 'situation' into an audible English mispronunciation, preserving Hokuto's correction in the next line.

edits.speaker: Hokushin
edits.before: If you would save the woman, surrender to us. Entrust to us that battle commander which jumps by the light of Daimolite.
edits.after: If you would save the woman, surrender to us. Entrust Daimos to us, the warrior that jumps by the light of Daimolite.
edits.reason: The epithet refers to Daimos, not a separate battle commander. Naming the machine clarifies what Hokushin demands while retaining his formal threat.

edits.speaker: Hokushin
edits.before: Their diversion has succeeded... Now I need only choose the right moment to withdraw.
edits.after: We've successfully drawn them out... Now I need only choose the right moment to withdraw.
edits.reason: Corrects the direction of the diversion: Hokushin has drawn the heroes out. 'Their diversion has succeeded' wrongly credits the targets with conducting it.

edits.speaker: Ruri
edits.before: Harry, divide the work with Omoikane and send the tracking program to the target computer, please.
edits.after: Harry, work with Omoikane to send the tracking program to the target computer, please.
edits.reason: Ruri is asking Harry and Omoikane to share the work. This replaces the awkward literal 'divide the work with' without changing the task.

edits.speaker: Fuyutsuki
edits.before: I never expected Tekkoryu (Iron Dragon) to target this place. Do they intend this as a preliminary battle...?
edits.after: I never expected Tekkoryu to target this place. Do they intend this as a preliminary battle...?
edits.reason: Removes an explanatory '(Iron Dragon)' gloss not spoken in the source, keeping the established faction name consistent with surrounding dialogue.

edits.speaker: Saiga
edits.before: Well, either way... A mere Zeorymer is no foe of mine.
edits.after: Well, either way... A mere Zeorymer isn't the enemy I'm after.
edits.reason: Saiga is implying that his real ambitions concern a greater enemy. 'No foe of mine' can instead suggest that Zeorymer is not hostile to him.

edits.speaker: Masato
edits.before: The me who tried to attack even if it dragged everyone in #部隊名 into it...!
edits.after: That other me who tried to attack without caring if everyone in #部隊名 was caught in it...!
edits.reason: Clarifies Masato's reference to his other personality endangering his allies, replacing the awkward and unclear 'dragged everyone ... into it'.

edits.speaker: #男愛称
edits.before: ...You're saying we should settle this, Captain!
edits.after: ...You're saying we should settle this, Commander!
edits.reason: Hugo is addressing his former squad leader, Albero. Uses the established 'Commander' translation of this address, rather than assigning him a Captain rank.

edits.speaker: #男愛称
edits.before: Here I come, Captain!!
edits.after: Here I come, Commander!!
edits.reason: Keeps Hugo's address for Albero consistent with 'Commander' elsewhere in the chapter.

edits.speaker: Masato
edits.before: Zeorymer! Call it back! Your Dimensional Coupler System!!
edits.after: Zeorymer! Call it back! Bring back your Dimensional Coupler System!!
edits.reason: Completes the English command: Masato is ordering the missing system component recalled, which the following scene reveals as Miku.

edits.speaker: Eldy
edits.before: Put this experience to use and become a proper TE Absorber pilot.
edits.after: Put this experience to use and become a fully qualified TE Absorber pilot.
edits.reason: The source refers to becoming a regular, qualified pilot rather than merely a 'proper' or well-behaved pilot.

edits.speaker: Member A
edits.before: ...Tekkoryu (Iron Dragon) seems to have entered the final phase of that plan.
edits.after: ...Tekkoryu seems to have entered the final phase of that plan.
edits.reason: Remove the unspoken parenthetical gloss for Tekkoryu, keeping the organization name consistent with the rest of the campaign.

edits.speaker: Saiga
edits.before: So, on the other hand... if our two machines join forces, we'll have no enemies in this world...!
edits.after: So... if our two machines join forces, no one in this world could stand against us...!
edits.reason: Here, having no enemies means being unbeatable, not literally having no opponents. Preserve the threat behind Saiga's proposed alliance.

edits.speaker: Saionji
edits.before: Now, Orie... What will you do if you let yourself get like this?
edits.after: Now, Orie... You can't lose heart like this.
edits.reason: Saionji is urging Orie to regain her resolve, not asking what action she will take if she becomes a certain way. Use a natural English admonition.

edits.speaker: Saionji
edits.before: However painful it is, that is your duty, and Shibuya and everyone in GEAR's... and #部隊名's, too.
edits.after: However painful it is, that is the duty of you, Shibuya and everyone in GEAR... and of #部隊名, too.
edits.reason: Recast the awkward chain of possessives so it clearly identifies everyone who shares the duty to protect the children and Earth.

status: applied to current full campaign sources and scoped context overrides
